title: Our Changing Planet: Big Question Opener

kostas.name: Kostas
kostas.persona: cheerful 10-year-old boy, playful and full of questions

focusWords.kidDefinition: A huge round world that moves around a star.
examples: Mars is a red planet near Earth.
Our planet has rivers, mountains and oceans.
focusWords.greekHint: Πλανήτης: think of the planet Πλάνη, a wanderer that moves around the sky.

focusWords.kidDefinition: To become different from how something was before.
examples: The sky can change very quickly in spring.
focusWords.greekHint: Αλλάζω: change the letters in your head, then change the word.

focusWords.kidDefinition: The sky and air outside: sunny, rainy, windy or cold.
examples: What is the weather like in Athens today?
Bad weather means we stay inside.
focusWords.greekHint: Καιρός: say it with a sunny face and a cloudy face.

focusWords.kidDefinition: All the land you can see, with hills, fields or mountains.
examples: The landscape near my village has green hills.
We painted a landscape with a river and trees.
focusWords.greekHint: Τοπίο: picture a postcard of the land around you.

focusWords.kidDefinition: A long line of water that flows to the sea.
examples: The river flows slowly into the blue sea.
Kids swim and fish in the river in summer.
focusWords.greekHint: Ποτάμι: a river runs like a long, moving line of water.

focusWords.kidDefinition: A very high place of land, higher than a hill.
examples: The mountain was covered in white snow.
We climbed the mountain and saw the whole valley.
focusWords.greekHint: Βουνό: a mountain is bigger and higher than a λόφος, a hill.

focusWords.kidDefinition: Water drops that fall from clouds in the sky.
examples: Heavy rain fell all afternoon, so we stayed home.
Rain helps the plants and flowers grow.
focusWords.greekHint: Βροχή: rain falls, so say it while you drop your fingers down.

focusWords.kidDefinition: A mountain with an opening where hot lava can come out.
examples: The volcano erupted and hot lava came out.
Scientists study the volcano to keep people safe.
focusWords.greekHint: Ηφαίστειο: Santorini's volcano is a famous example.

lines.text: Hello, friends! I am Lingo, and I love looking at our world.
Our world is big. It has mountains, rivers, lakes and beaches.
Sometimes the sky is sunny. Sometimes it is cold and wet.
Our planet is always changing. Can you see the changes?

question.text: What changes do you notice in nature around you?

prompt.text: Point to the picture of a huge round world that moves around a star.

explain.text: A planet is a huge round world that moves around a star.

prompt.text: Our planet can ____ slowly over a long time.

explain.text: To change means to become different from how something was before.

prompt.text: Weather is the sky and air outside, like sunny, rainy or cold.

explain.text: Yes, the weather tells us what the sky and air are like today.

prompt.text: Which word is the odd one out?

explain.text: Mountain, volcano and landscape are all land, but a river is water.
A mountain is a very high place of land, higher than a hill.

prompt.text: Scientists watch the ____ carefully because hot lava can come out of its top.

explain.text: A volcano is a mountain with an opening where hot lava comes out.

prompt.text: Rain is water that falls from the clouds in the sky.

explain.text: Rain is made of water drops that fall from clouds.

prompt.text: Point to the picture of all the land you can see around you.

explain.text: A landscape is all the land you can see around you.

prompt.text: What's the ____ like today? It is sunny and warm.

explain.text: We ask about the weather to find out if the day is sunny, rainy or cold.

lines.text: Time to play memory! Match each picture with its word.
Say the word out loud when you find a pair. Ready, set, go!

prompt.text: Tell your partner about the weather and landscape where you live.

frames: In my country, the weather is ___.
Near my home, there is a ___.
I like the ___ because it is ___.

model.text: In my country, the weather is hot in summer. Near my home, there is a mountain. I like the river because it is cool and calm.

lines.text: Brilliant work, everyone! You met planet, weather and volcano today.
Our planet is changing, and you are ready to explore why.

exitTicket.text: Name one thing in nature that can change over time.
What is the difference between a mountain and a volcano?
